entry.title: Arcade Beast
entry.summary:
Vendor: ZeroLifestyle.co
Type: Earbuds
Price: 5999.00 - 7999.00 (4 variants)

Arcade Beast by Zero Lifestyle

Features of Product

Sleek and Tactical Design

Built for both performance and style, the Arcade Beast earbuds come in four bold colorways—Black, Grey, Blue, and White.

  • Compact Build: Earbuds measure 34.3 × 20.4 × 20 mm

  • Portable Charging Case: Dimensions are 58.1 × 45.8 × 27.3 mm

  • Lightweight: Total weight of just 44.53 g ensures a snug and effortless fit

Long Battery Life & Efficient Charging

Game, stream, and talk all day with powerful battery support and quick recharging.

  • Total Playtime: Up to 30 hours of usage time

  • Single Charge Playback: Around 6 hours at moderate volume

  • Charging Time: Fully recharges in about 1 hour

  • Power Setup:

    • Type-C Input: DC 5V/1A

    • Case Input Power: 5W

    • Case Output: 1.2W

  • Battery Specs:

    • Earbuds: 40mAh

    • Case: 400mAh

    • Battery Manufacturer: Golden Universe / Henan Wanli / Hunan Lirui

  • Standby Time: Up to 40 hours

Seamless Wireless Connectivity

Stay connected with ultra-reliable Bluetooth and real-time responsiveness.

  • Bluetooth Version: V5.4 for faster, more stable pairing

  • Connectivity Range: Operates smoothly within 10 meters

  • Personalized Device Name: Recognized as “Arcade Beast”

  • Advanced Protocols: A2DP 1.4, AVRCP 1.6.2, HFP 1.7.2, and more

  • Smart Features:

    • Auto Pairing

    • Popup Pairing

    • Hyper Sync

    • Master-Slave Switching

Smart Controls & Voice Activation

Take control with effortless taps and voice commands.

  • Voice Assistant: Activate Siri or Google Assistant with four taps on the left earbud

  • Touch Interaction: Fully responsive interface for easy control

  • Quick Pairing & Smart Sync: Pair instantly without digging into settings

Immersive Audio & Durability

Engineered for powerful sound clarity and endurance.

  • Driver Platform: Powered by JL 7006F8 chip for clean, balanced audio

  • Audio Format: SBC supported

  • Water Resistance: Splash-ready for daily wear (IPX rating not specified)

Specifications of Product

  • Earbud Dimensions: 34.3 × 20.4 × 20 mm

  • Charging Case Dimensions: 58.1 × 45.8 × 27.3 mm

  • Total Weight: 44.53 g

  • Charging Time: 1 hour

  • Bluetooth Version: V5.4

  • Battery Capacity: 40mAh (earbud), 400mAh (case)

  • Playback Time: 6 hours (single charge), 30 hours total

Package Includes

  • Arcade Beast Earbuds (Left & Right)

  • Charging Case

  • Replaceable Eartips

  • Type-C Charging Cable

Why Choose Arcade Beast?

Level up your lifestyle with Arcade Beast—a bold fusion of form, power, and real-time audio performance. Built for gamers, streamers, and go-getters, these earbuds are your companion for every battle, beat drop, and call. Plug in. Lock on. Beast Mode: Activated.

entry.title: Striker Earbuds
entry.summary:
Vendor: ZeroLifestyle.co
Type: Earbuds
Price: 5999.00 - 7999.00 (8 variants)

Striker Earbuds by Zero Lifestyle

Features of Product

Sleek and Dynamic Design

Crafted for style and comfort, the Striker Earbuds are available in three bold color choices—Black, Green, and Camo.

  • Compact Build: Earbuds measure 34.99 × 21.15 × 24.88 mm.

  • Portable Charging Case: Dimensions of 60.73 × 63.96 × 42.44 mm.

  • Lightweight: Total weight of just 48.9 g, ensuring a comfortable fit for extended use.

Long Battery Life & Efficient Charging

Enjoy uninterrupted performance with a robust battery setup.

  • Extended Playtime: Up to 27.5 hours in total, with approximately 5.5 hours of continuous playback at 70% volume.

  • Fast Charging: Fully recharges in about 2 hours via a Type-C input (1W for the case, 0.5W output).

  • Reliable Batteries: Powered by Jingshan Yifan Energy Co., Ltd. with an earbud battery capacity of 35mAh and a case capacity of 400mAh.

  • Standby Duration: Earbuds last about 60 days; charging case lasts up to 120 days.

Seamless Wireless Connectivity

Experience effortless pairing and uninterrupted listening.

  • Latest Bluetooth Version: Equipped with Bluetooth V5.4 for stable connections.

  • Reliable Range: Maintains connectivity within ≥10 meters.

  • Hassle-Free Pairing: Supports automatic pairing for an effortless user experience.

  • Game Mode: Low-latency performance with 65ms response time for immersive gaming.

Intuitive Touch & Voice Controls

Enjoy easy management with sensitive touch controls.

  • Play/Pause: Single tap on either earbud.

  • Call Handling: Answer with a tap, double-tap to hang up, long press (2–3 seconds) to reject.

  • Voice Assistant Activation: Long press the left earbud (3 seconds) for Siri or Google Assistant.

  • Gaming Mode: Long press the right earbud (3 seconds) for a low-latency experience.

  • Factory Reset: Tap five times while pairing L & R, then place them in the case and remove to confirm reset.

Superior Audio Experience

Immerse yourself in powerful sound clarity.

  • High-Quality Drivers: 13mm audio drivers deliver a frequency range of 20Hz–20kHz.

  • Optimized Sensitivity: 111.5±3dB ensures balanced sound performance.

  • Clear Calls: Equipped with a 2718 silicone microphone for superior voice capture.

  • AI ENC Technology: Enhances call noise reduction for crisp conversations.

  • Water Resistance: Certified IPX4 for protection against splashes and light rain.

Specifications of Product

  • Earbud Dimensions: 34.99 × 21.15 × 24.88 mm

  • Charging Case Dimensions: 60.73 × 63.96 × 42.44 mm

  • Total Weight: 48.9 g

  • Charging Time: About 2 hours

  • Bluetooth Version: V5.4, supports multiple protocols

  • Audio Decoding: SBC

  • Microphone: Single MIC

  • Touch Control: Fully responsive interface

Package Includes

  • Striker Earbuds (Left & Right)

  • Charging Case

  • Replaceable Eartips

  • Charging Cable

Why Choose the Striker Earbuds?

Designed for those who demand excellence, the Striker Earbuds by Zero Lifestyle bring together cutting-edge technology and a modern aesthetic. Whether you're making calls, gaming, or enjoying music, these earbuds are built to elevate your lifestyle.

entry.title: Zero Arcade 900
entry.summary:
Vendor: ZeroLifestyle.co
Type: Earbuds
Price: 6499.00

The Arcade Series Gaming Earbuds

Pakistan’s First Gaming Earbuds, making it the ultimate wireless companion for every gamer. Powered with 40M/S Hyper Low Latency, RGB Case & Buds along with 50 Hour Standby Playback time, the Arcade Series is your gaming studio in your pocket.

Features of Arcade 900

  • Hyper Low Latency: Experience true wireless freedom without any lagging with The Arcade Series 40M/S Hyper Low Latency, giving you reliable connections at ultra-fast speed.
  • RGB Case & Buds: Personalize your victory, wherever and whenever with the Arcade Series’ sleek design paired with RGB LED lights in your case and earbuds, making a style statement for every gamer.
  • Incredible Audio Immersion: Enjoy high-resolution audio with 10MM HyperBass Drivers, transporting you to your in-game environment.
  • Unbeatable Battery Life with Ultra Fast Charging: With 50 hours standby playback, your gaming sessions never end. Power up with ultra-fast charging, giving you 120 minutes of playback in just 10 minutes!

Specifications of Arcade 900

  • Auto Gaming Mode: Full-color touch screen.
  • Touch Controls: Heart rate monitor, sleep analysis.
  • ENC & Quad Mic: Steps, calories, various exercise modes.
  • Hyper Low Latency: Smart notifications for calls, texts, and social media.
  • AI Voice Assistant: Long-lasting, multi-day battery life on a single charge.
  • IPX5 Water Resistance: Suitable for intense workouts.

Why Choose the Arcade 900

If you’re looking for the true wireless experience to enhance your gaming, whether you’re at home, on the go, or in your studio, then the Arcade Series is a must-have for every gamer. Even if you’re not into gaming and just looking for something to stream, the Arcade Series offers over 50 hours of playback battery with HyperBass audio, giving you the vibes you want in every beat.
